title: GUI DDE DATA proxy route map
contracts: DDE request data replies are routed by pending request identity rather than by one process-global proxy HWND
The route key is real client HWND plus the DDE item atom carried by WM_DDE_REQUEST and WM_DDE_DATA
DdeProxyThreadSlave extracts the WM_DDE_REQUEST item atom with UnpackDDElParam before registering the proxy HWND
Gui_DDE_DATA_Posting sends the real client HWND and WM_DDE_DATA item atom through GUI_SEND_COPYDATA
SendCopyDataSlave takes and removes the matching route before posting the private DDE DATA hop
Missing routes fail without posting to an unrelated proxy window
Windows runtime proof is still required for overlapping DDE request/data behavior
local_edges: DdeProxyThreadSlave WM_DDE_REQUEST -> UnpackDDElParam -> Dde_SetRequestProxyWnd client item proxy
Gui_DDE_DATA_Posting WM_DDE_DATA -> UnpackDDElParam -> GUI_SEND_COPYDATA hwnd client cds_key item
SendCopyDataSlave which dde -> Dde_TakeRequestProxyWnd client item -> PostMessage matched proxy
DdeProxyThreadSlave private WM_USER hop -> PostMessage client WM_DDE_DATA
runtime_gate: Windows SbieSvc and DLL build with two overlapping DDE request/data replies returning through their own proxy windows and missing-route failure proof
